before.name: Mode
before.description: The permission mode the next generation is judged under. auto is unavailable in this session. It needs a configured [permissions] judge: ego config set 'permissions.judge="openai-codex/gpt-6.1-sol"'. If this session uses a profile, add --profile <name> to that command. Start a new session after configuration. The session max_mode can also restrict auto.
